explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1053. On the set of multiply perfect numbers (n > 0 with σ(n) = kn for some k, via Nat.IsPerfectFor n 1 k), the multiplier σ(n)/n is o(log log n) as n → ∞ along that set, encoded with the filter atTop ⊓ 𝓟 S. If S were finite the statement would hold vacuously, but then Erdős's question would also be vacuous, so this is the right reading of an open question.
